title: Grayed PVP Essentials
description: An PVP texture pack that adds many essentials pvp features and some textures.
body:
this PVP Pack features:
- low fire
- fullbright
- no explosion or hit particles
- no eat and break particles
- no firework particles
- small handheld item model 
- no totem pop particles
- small totem pop
- money totem pop sound (Credits to Bluekingaxolotl's project)
- many custom item and block textures
- an custom start menu
